title: template.massadd
description: Simultaneously add multiple related objects to the given templates.

templates.description: Templates to be updated. The templates must have only the templateid property defined. Parameter behavior: required.

groups.description: Template groups to add the given templates to. The template groups must have only the groupid property defined.

macros.description: User macros to be created for the given templates. See the User macro object (reference/usermacro/object).

templates_link.description: Templates to link to the given templates. The templates must have only the templateid property defined.

templateGroupRef.description: Reference to an existing template group by groupid only.

templateRef.description: Reference to an existing template by templateid only.
